info.title: TechRat API
info.description: Gamified tech learning platform. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login (bearer) or ?useCookies=true (web).

post.summary: Add a step to a module (bumps the module version when it already had steps)

put.summary: Replace the roadmap's ordered module list (order, required flags; unlisted modules are removed)

post.summary: Send a test email (to the given address or to the signed-in admin) to check the SMTP settings
Create an account with email and password
post.description: The password has 8 to 128 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit, is not a very common password ("Password1", "Summer2024!") and does not contain the username or the part of the email before the @.

post.summary: Sign in. Web uses useCookies=true (HttpOnly cookie); mobile/desktop receive bearer + refresh tokens
Exchange a refresh token for a new access token
Sign out (clears the cookie and invalidates refresh tokens)
Send a password reset email. Always returns 202 to avoid account enumeration
post.description: Answers 202 after the same work for every address, known or not; the email is sent afterwards, at most once a minute per address. The link in it works for one hour.

post.summary: Reset the password using the code from the email
post.description: The code expires one hour after the email was sent. The new password follows the sign-up rules. A missing or wrong field answers 400 in the same shape for known and unknown accounts.

get.summary: Whether the signed-in account has a password (change it) or not (set one)

post.summary: Change (or set) the password of the signed-in account
post.description: Checks the current password on the server (failures count towards lockout) and applies the sign-up rules. Every other session is signed out. The calling session continues: a cookie session gets a renewed cookie (204), a bearer session gets new tokens (200). The owner is emailed.

get.summary: External login providers and whether they are enabled

delete.summary: Permanently delete the signed-in account and its data
delete.description: Requires the current password (failures count towards lockout) or, for accounts without a password, the username typed as confirmation. Deletes the credentials, profile, photo, progress, XP, achievements, notifications and every session; all tokens stop working at once and the owner is emailed. The last administrator cannot delete the account (409). This cannot be undone.

get.summary: Module catalog: reusable modules shared by roadmaps, with the learner's progress when signed in
Study resources: the topics to master in the module and the sources to learn each from

post.summary: Start a practice session: Practice, Challenge, Random or Adaptive (topic optional: without one, the whole question bank), a roadmap step, or Learn with the chosen questionIds
Grade an answer: returns feedback, explanation, reference, XP, levels, streak and roadmap progress

get.summary: Global, Weekly, Monthly or Topic leaderboard
Study resources: general overview reading for the roadmap (books, official docs, courses), in the request language

post.summary: Enrol in a roadmap (fails with 403 while prerequisites are not met; administrators are never blocked)

get.summary: Knowledge tree: topics, subtopics and question counts
Topic library: the curated reading of the modules that teach the topic plus the pages its questions cite, in the request language
Learn: the topic's questions (filter by subtopic and difficulty) with the learner's latest result on each; answer the chosen ones with a Learn session

put.description: The client crops the photo to a square and compresses it (512×512 recommended). JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 1 MB, detected from the file signature. Replaces the previous photo and returns the updated user.

delete.summary: Remove the profile photo and go back to the default avatar

get.summary: A user's uploaded profile photo (public, cacheable; the avatarUrl of a user points here)
Home dashboard: stats, continue learning, current roadmap, recommendations, daily challenge
Public profile with topic levels, achievements, roadmap progress and activity
